entries.title: Psalms 102:1
segments: ¶<<A Prayer of the afflicted when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD.>> Hear my prayer, O LORD, And let my cry come to You.

entries.title: Psalms 102:2
segments: Do not hide Your face from me in the day of my trouble; Incline Your ear to me; In the day that I call, answer me speedily.

entries.title: Psalms 102:3
segments: For my days are consumed like smoke, And my bones are burned like a hearth.

entries.title: Psalms 102:4
segments: My heart is stricken and withered like grass, So that I forget to eat my bread.

entries.title: Psalms 102:5
segments: Because of the sound of my groaning My bones cling to my skin.

entries.title: Psalms 102:6
segments: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am like an owl of the desert.

entries.title: Psalms 102:7
segments: I lie awake, And am like a sparrow alone on the housetop.

entries.title: Psalms 102:8
segments: My enemies reproach me all day long, Those who deride me swear an oath against me.

entries.title: Psalms 102:9
segments: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,

entries.title: Psalms 102:10
segments: Because of Your indignation and Your wrath; For You have lifted me up and cast me away.

entries.title: Psalms 102:11
segments: My days [are] like a shadow that lengthens, And I wither away like grass.

entries.title: Psalms 102:12
segments: ¶But You, O LORD, shall endure forever, And the remembrance of Your name to all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 102:13
segments: You will arise [and] have mercy on Zion; For the time to favor her, Yes, the set time, has come.

entries.title: Psalms 102:14
segments: For Your servants take pleasure in her stones, And show favor to her dust.

entries.title: Psalms 102:15
segments: So the nations shall fear the name of the LORD, And all the kings of the earth Your glory.

entries.title: Psalms 102:16
segments: For the LORD shall build up Zion; He shall appear in His glory.

entries.title: Psalms 102:17
segments: He shall regard the prayer of the destitute, And shall not despise their prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 102:18
segments: This will be written for the generation to come, That a people yet to be created may praise the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 102:19
segments: For He looked down from the height of His sanctuary; From heaven the LORD viewed the earth,

entries.title: Psalms 102:20
segments: To hear the groaning of the prisoner, To release those appointed to death,

entries.title: Psalms 102:21
segments: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, And His praise in Jerusalem,

entries.title: Psalms 102:22
segments: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 102:23
segments: ¶He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

entries.title: Psalms 102:24
segments: I said, "O my God, Do not take me away in the midst of my days; Your years [are] throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 102:25
segments: Of old You laid the foundation of the earth, And the heavens [are] the work of Your hands.

entries.title: Psalms 102:26
segments: They will perish, but You will endure; Yes, they will all grow old like a garment; Like a cloak You will change them, And they will be changed.

entries.title: Psalms 102:27
segments: But You [are] the same, And Your years will have no end.

entries.title: Psalms 102:28
segments: The children of Your servants will continue, And their descendants will be established before You."
